name: 19943 · Felton, DE
findings: ZIP 19943 (Felton) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19943 (Felton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
